title: gui-player configuration
description: Structure of gui-player.json, which lives next to the executable. gui-player creates it (filled with the defaults below) when it does not exist.

settings.description: User settings as a list of {key, value} pairs. Values are stored as text and checked against the type of their entry in x-settings; a missing or invalid value falls back to its default.

maxLastOpened.description: Maximum number of files kept in lastOpened (the oldest are dropped).

windowMaximized.description: Whether the window was left maximized. When false, the window opens restored, at windowX/windowY with windowWidth x windowHeight.

windowX.description: Horizontal position of the restored window. No default: without it (or without windowY) the system places the window.

windowY.description: Vertical position of the restored window. No default: see windowX.

windowWidth.description: Width of the restored window, in points.

tabsWidthPercent.description: Share of the top row's width taken by the tabs panel (A); the properties panel (B) gets the rest. Position of the vertical divider.

topHeightPercent.description: Share of the height taken by the top row (A + B); the arrangement (C) gets the rest. Position of the horizontal divider.

windowHeight.description: Height of the restored window, in points.

lastOpened.description: History of the compositions opened, most recent first. Both key and value are the file's absolute path.
